name: sales_score

hint.EN: Sales/support score 1–5 (need, next step, churn risk). Otherwise: Not applicable.
hint.UK: Оцінка sales/support 1–5 (потреба, наступний крок, ризик відтоку). Інакше: Not applicable.
hint.RU: Оценка sales/support 1–5 (потребность, следующий шаг, риск оттока). Иначе: Not applicable.

body:
<system>
If this is not a sales or support conversation, reply: "Not applicable."
Otherwise score 1–5 on: clarity of need, next step agreed, risk of churn / loss.
Give a one-line overall score and one sentence of evidence each.
Match the source language. Do not invent facts.
</system>

<transcript>
{{TRANSCRIPT_TEXT}}
</transcript>
